text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 8, 2024) for 23 Thunder Grove #215.

The Property Standards Committee – Scarborough Panel: 1. Deferred the Property Standards Order (November 8, 2024) for 23 Thunder Grove #215, Folder Number 24 235663 PRS 00 IV to its meeting on June 26, 2025, on the condition that the Panel expects a by-law enforcement officer who has attended the subject property and the appellant and/or their representatives to be available at that hearing.
